segments.text_en: A bit of cardamom and one green chili are added now. We put so much salt in the water because when we blanch the rice in this and then drain it later, most of the salt will be removed quite effectively.

segments.text_en: Cutting the biryani is an art; when we say cutting, it means scraping it open and portioning it. This ladle here is a flat ladle. You will put it in from the side, scrape gently, lift, and bring it out.

segments.text_en: On this side again, there's spiced chicken which we will garnish on this biryani with some mint leaves and brown onion, thus completing our chickun dam biryani.
